faq.q: Is there a median price for Chilliwack townhomes under $1.2M?
faq.a: No figure is stated in this file: Chilliwack is CADREB territory, SnapStats has no Chilliwack coverage, and CADREB publishes board-wide statistics only, so no band count, share or median exists in program sources (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report, read 2026-11-01)

faq.q: Does a new Chilliwack townhome under $1.2M qualify for a property transfer tax exemption?
faq.a: A qualifying newly built home bought as a principal residence is fully exempt at $1,100,000 or less, with a partial exemption phasing out between $1,100,000 and $1,150,000, effective April 1, 2024

faq.q: Which schools serve the Sardis and Promontory townhome areas, by name and address?
faq.a: Promontory Heights Community Elementary at 46200 Stoneview Dr, Vedder Elementary at 45850 Promontory Rd, Vedder Middle School at 45560 South Sumas Rd and Sardis Secondary at 45460 Stevenson Rd, Chilliwack, all confirmed in the BC Ministry K-12 file; catchments are address-based and must be run per address (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01)

faq.q: What zoning bylaw governs Chilliwack townhomes, and what is its SSMUH amendment?
faq.a: Chilliwack Zoning Bylaw 5000 governs, and its small-scale multi-unit housing amendment is Bylaw 5395, adopted June 18, 2024 (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01)
